in_sanskrit.name: Akhirul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है The Last One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Akhirul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Akhirul is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Akhira' meaning 'last' and 'Rul' meaning 'one'. It is believed that this name was given to the last surviving member of a clan or dynasty.
